title: Normalized completed-to-native coefficient inclusion
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ and a $\mathbf Q_\ell$-embedding $i:E\to\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Fix a NativeGeometry for $\ell$ [def-sf-locally-finite-adic-compact-support-data]. There is a Change from the completed integral coefficient system for $E$ to the native locally finite coefficient system, commuting with inverse image along every scheme morphism [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data]. For every scheme $T$ and every normalized CoefficientPresentation $C$ of $E$ on $T$ with embedding $i$ [def-sf-locally-finite-adic-realization-data], its map at $T$ is exactly $C.integralMap$: inverse completion identification, normalized integral-to-rational inclusion, then normalized inclusion into the native function sheaf. This statement constructs coefficient maps only; it constructs no compact-support natural transformation.

theorem native_completed_coefficient_change [G : NativeGeometry.{u} l]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (i : E →ₐ[Padic l] PadicAlgCl l) :
    ∃ a : PurCompactSupport.Change (PurCompactSupport.completed l E) (nativeCoefficients l),
      ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (C : CoefficientPresentation l T E i),
        a.map T = C.integralMap l T
